name: DataTable
description: Generic typed data table built on TanStack React Table. Supports pagination, sorting, expansion, row selection and custom column renderers

props.name: data
props.description: The data to be shown in the table. See https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/guide/data

props.name: columns
props.description: The column configuration table. See https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/guide/column-defs

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Is table full width

props.name: enableRowSelection
props.description: Show a checkbox column and enables selection

props.name: enableMultiRowSelection
props.description: Enables selection of multiple rows

props.name: selections
props.description: Specify the selected rows. If `undefined`, the selections are managed internally Object with the key of row ID and a bo…
props.descriptionFull: Specify the selected rows. If `undefined`, the selections are managed internally Object with the key of row ID and a boolean specifying if the row is selected. The default row ID is the index. This can be changed using `getRowId` prop

props.name: onSelectionsChange
props.description: Callback to be called when the row are selected / unselected

props.name: enablePagination
props.description: Show pagination

props.name: bordered
props.description: Add borders to all cells

props.name: pagination
props.description: Specify the pagination params. Object of shape { pageIndex: number, pageSize: number }. If `undefined` then the paginat…
props.descriptionFull: Specify the pagination params. Object of shape { pageIndex: number, pageSize: number }. If `undefined` then the pagination is managed internally

props.name: onPaginationChange
props.description: Callback to be called when the pagination params change

props.name: sorting
props.description: Specify the sorting params. If `undefined` then the sorting is managed internally

props.name: defaultSorting
props.description: Default sorting applied when the table is first mounted (uncontrolled mode). Ignored when `sorting` is provided

props.name: onSortingChange
props.description: Callback to be called when the sorting changes

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classname of the wrapper element

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classname of the content element

props.name: tableClassName
props.description: Classname of the table element

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a loading indicator overlay

props.name: enableRowExpansion
props.description: Show a columns with a button which can expand the row

props.name: canRowExpand
props.description: Callback to check if a row can be expanded

props.name: expandedRows
props.description: Specify the expanded rows If `undefined`, the expansions are managed internally Object with the key of row ID and a boo…
props.descriptionFull: Specify the expanded rows If `undefined`, the expansions are managed internally Object with the key of row ID and a boolean specifying if the row is selected. The default row ID is the index. This can be changed using `getRowId` prop

props.name: onExpandedRowsChange
props.description: Callback to be called when the rows are expanded or collapsed

props.name: renderExpandedContent
props.description: Render the content of the expanded row. Required when `enableRowExpansion` is `true`

props.name: getRowId
props.type: ((row: I, index: number, parent?: Row<I> | undefined) => string)
props.description: Get the row ID for a row. If not specified index is the default row ID

props.name: onRowClick
props.description: Called when a body row is clicked. When set, rows become interactive (pointer cursor, `role="button"`, keyboard-activat…
props.descriptionFull: Called when a body row is clicked. When set, rows become interactive (pointer cursor, `role="button"`, keyboard-activatable with Enter/Space). Clicks originating from an interactive control in the row (button, link, input, checkbox, or anything marked `data-no-row-click`) are ignored, so the selection checkbox and expand toggle keep working independently
